answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 5 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The wander counter is kept in signal and nebula publishes each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. The attacker spends 79 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
